module_dispositions.rationale: Worked alignment narrative that motivates the executable procedures in §§769–812.
Alignrecord field aliases used by the lifecycle and packing properties.
Alignment-stack fields and global-variable declarations used by §§771–772.
Initial null values for alignment-stack and active-alignment cursors.
TeX82 push_alignment and pop_alignment save and restore the listed alignment variables.
Procedure-order overview; each named procedure is claimed below.
Alignment initialization, packing specification, mode transition, and display recovery.
Preamble list construction, delimiter identities, tabskip assignment, span expansion, and interwoven recovery.
Distinct u- and v-template scanning and malformed-parameter recovery.
Row lookahead selects noalign, finish, ignored crcr, or a new row.
Row semantic level, mode switch, and leading tabskip lifecycle.
Span semantic-level initialization in horizontal and vertical alignments.
Cell opening, u-template replay, delimiter interception, v-template replay, and omit-template selection.
End-v validation, cell/span completion, periodic extension, and extra-tab recovery.
Natural cell packing and unset-node glue summaries.
Ordered span-node representation and maximum natural-width update.
Mode-dependent natural row packing, adjustment movement, every_cr, and lookahead.
fin_align group removal, packing phases, alignment-stack pop, and environment insertion.
Canonical column-width recurrence, null-column tabskip zeroing, and destructive ordered span merge.
Saved to/spread specification packages the horizontal or vertical prototype.
Unset-list traversal and running rule dimensions from the prototype.
Row prototype transfer and explicit tabskip/empty-box material for spanned cells.
Mode-specific unset-cell conversion and glue ratio calculation.
Completed alignment insertion into display, vertical, or horizontal surroundings.
Missing-brace correction and misplaced alignment-command diagnostics.
Main-control alignment dispatch context for init_align and do_endv.
Effective end-v validation, active align-group completion, and off-save recovery.
Alignment-group right brace is backed up behind an inserted frozen cr.
Noalign group closure resumes alignment row lookahead.
Display alignment assignment scan, missing-double-math-shift diagnostic and backup recovery, list insertion, and display resumption.

properties.claim: TeX82 initializes align_ptr, cur_align, cur_span, cur_loop, cur_head, and cur_tail to null before alignment processing begins.
preconditions: TeX82 initialization is executing before any alignment has been started.
expected_observations: All six alignment pointers are null after the initialization fragment.
postconditions: No saved or active alignment record, loop, span, or adjustment list is selected.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: observe the initial values before the first halign or valign.
Boundary: begin the first alignment immediately after initialization and confirm push_alignment sees a null outer stack.
recovery_cases: Recovery: §771 specifies initialization, not error recovery; no malformed-input branch is asserted.

properties.claim: push_alignment stores cur_align, preamble, cur_span, cur_loop, align_state, cur_head, and cur_tail in a new stack node and gives the inner alignment a fresh cur_head; pop_alignment frees the inner cur_head, restores those stored values, advances align_ptr, and frees the stack node.
preconditions: An outer alignment state exists and push_alignment or pop_alignment is called at the canonical alignment boundary.
stimulus: Existing unit `nested_alignment_resume_preserves_outer_align_state`; Phase 2 unit `push_pop_alignment_restores_all_tex82_fields` and semantic case `alignment-nested-state-stack`.
expected_observations: A nested push preserves every field named by §772, and the matching pop restores their exact prior values.
postconditions: After pop_alignment, the outer preamble, cursors, align_state, and adjustment-list head/tail again equal their pre-push values.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: one nested halign and one nested valign restore the outer alignment state.
Boundary: nonnull cur_loop, active cur_span, nonzero align_state, and nonempty adjustment head/tail are each preserved across one push/pop pair.
recovery_cases: Recovery: §772 defines no recovery branch; tests assert only the stated push_alignment and pop_alignment preconditions and effects.

properties.claim: init_align pushes alignment state, installs the preamble sentinel, enters the opposite internal mode, scans the optional to/spread specification and opening brace, and rejects prior display material before preamble scanning.
preconditions: A legal halign/valign command is delivered in its admitted outer mode, optionally as the sole display material.
stimulus: Phase 2 units `alignment_scan_spec_consumes_brace_after_keyword_backups` and `alignment_initial_mode_matrix`; semantic cases `alignment-spec-modes` and `alignment-improper-display`.
expected_observations: Specification kind/value, align-group creation, preamble sentinel -1000000, and mode transition occur in TeX82 order.
postconditions: Preamble scanning owns a fresh alignment level and the enclosing prev_depth is preserved where TeX82 requires it.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: initialize halign in vertical mode, valign in horizontal mode, and halign as the sole display material.
Boundary: direct, to, and spread specifications; nested initialization; and prior display material that must be flushed.
recovery_cases: Recovery: improper display material is flushed with the canonical diagnostic; missing specification brace uses compulsory-brace recovery.

properties.claim: Preamble scanning alternates copied tabskip glue with alignrecords, assigns distinct span/cr/crcr modifiers, expands only span-following tokens and tabskip specifications, and ends at a top-level cr.
preconditions: Alignment specification scanning has consumed its opening brace and align_state is -1000000.
expected_observations: Local/global tabskip updates and frozen delimiter identities are visible while ordinary preamble tokens remain unexpanded.
postconditions: The preamble has leading/intercolumn/trailing glue, frozen column pairs, periodic-loop identity if selected, and scanner status returns to normal.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: scan outer and nested halign/valign preambles with local and global tabskip changes.
Boundary: nested template braces, empty/nonempty pairs, span-triggered expansion, ordinary tab, cr, crcr, and a top-level terminating cr.
recovery_cases: Recovery: effective endv during preamble scanning raises interwoven-preamble failure; exhausted preamble input follows aligning-status EOF recovery.

properties.claim: The u-template drops leading spaces and ends at its first top-level parameter marker; the v-template retains tokens through its top-level delimiter, discards extra parameter markers with diagnostics, and appends frozen end-template.
preconditions: Preamble scanning is active at a new alignrecord.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `scan_u_v_templates_empty_nested_and_malformed` and semantic cases `alignment-template-scan` and `alignment-template-recovery`.
expected_observations: Frozen u/v token lists preserve braces and delimiter boundaries, with exactly one end-template appended to v.
postconditions: Every completed column has one u/v pair; empty u and v lists retain their canonical lifecycle distinctions.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: empty and token-rich u/v pairs in halign and valign, including repeated columns.
Boundary: leading u spaces, nested braces, the first parameter marker, an extra v parameter marker, missing parameter before tab/cr, and the first eligible empty-u double tab.
recovery_cases: Recovery: missing # backs up the top-level tab/cr for v scanning; extra # is discarded and v scanning continues; empty-u && selects periodic repetition only at the first eligible site.

properties.claim: align_peek resets align_state to 1000000, skips blanks and expandable calls, starts noalign after consuming its brace, finishes on right brace, ignores crcr, or backs up and starts a row and first cell.
preconditions: Preamble completion or fin_row has reached row lookahead.
expected_observations: Every initial or crcr-restarted probe publishes align_state 1000000; exactly one branch owns the lookahead token, and an ordinary row orders reset, command-owned backup, then u-template installation.
postconditions: The engine is in noalign group, alignment finish, repeated lookahead, or a new row/cell with no duplicated token.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: select noalign, alignment close, ignored crcr, and ordinary new-row branches in outer and nested alignments.
Boundary: blank/expandable prefixes, malformed noalign opener, closing right brace, repeated crcr, and empty/nonempty first u-template.
recovery_cases: Recovery: malformed noalign opener uses scan_left_brace recovery; repeated crcr remains bounded and does not create an empty row.

properties.claim: init_row pushes one semantic level, switches halign to restricted horizontal mode or valign to internal vertical mode, appends the first tabskip, and begins a span at the first alignrecord.
preconditions: align_peek selected a real row and the preamble contains its leading glue and first alignrecord.
expected_observations: One leading tabskip precedes the first cell; halign rows have raw space_factor 0 and valign rows have prev_depth 0; the nested span level has space_factor 1000 or ignore_depth, and typed row state identifies first alignrecord/cur_span plus omit/span structure.
postconditions: cur_align and cur_span select the first column and the row list is ready for cell packaging.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: start first and later rows of halign and valign with their leading tabskip.
Boundary: empty/nonempty first-cell templates, nondefault auxiliary fields, and an initial one-column or multi-column span.
recovery_cases: Recovery: an empty or exhausted preamble is rejected before row initialization rather than manufacturing a column.

properties.claim: init_span pushes a semantic nest, sets space_factor to 1000 in restricted horizontal mode or sets prev_depth to ignore_depth and calls normal_paragraph in internal vertical mode, then assigns cur_span to its argument.
preconditions: A row has started or a completed nonspan cell advances to another span start.
stimulus: Committed command-semantic case `span-start` observes the remaining boundary as a strict xfail linked to umber2-hq8l.
expected_observations: The span start is the current column and subsequent span delimiters retain the same cell-list level.
postconditions: The current list is empty on its new semantic level, the mode auxiliary field has the §787 value, and cur_span names the first alignrecord of the span.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: start one-column and multiple-column spans in halign and valign.
Boundary: enter valign with paragraph state requiring normal_paragraph and halign with nondefault space_factor.
recovery_cases: Recovery: §787 defines no error branch; tests assert only calls satisfying init_span preconditions.
The strict xfail pins the first canonical-versus-current mismatch and rejects XPASS or changed failure.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

properties.claim: An ordinary cell backs up its first token and replays the selected u-template, whose exhaustion changes align_state from 1000000 to 0; a top-level delimiter then selects the saved v-template and restores 1000000, while omit bypasses u and selects only frozen end-template.
preconditions: A row/span is active, cur_align selects a frozen column, and lookahead has delivered omit or the cell's first token.
stimulus: Existing units `active_alignment_predicate_tracks_scanner_levels_not_only_cells` and `completed_alignment_cell_retires_exhausted_v_template_boundary`; Phase 2 unit `cell_template_delivery_matrix` and semantic case `alignment-cell-template-delivery`.
expected_observations: Ordinary cells begin the selected u-template after back_input; omit sets align_state to zero; a delimiter at zero records cur_chr, begins the selected v/omit template, and sets align_state to 1000000.
postconditions: The v-template or omit_template ends with frozen end-template and the intercepted delimiter remains in extra_info for fin_col.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: ordinary and omitted cells ending with tab, span, cr, and crcr in halign and valign.
Boundary: empty/nonempty u/v lists, physical brace depths versus brace control-sequence aliases, nested box/alignment material, and delimiter delivery at align_state zero and ±1.
recovery_cases: Recovery: delimiter at align_state ±1 triggers missing-brace correction; delimiter during aligning or without cur_align reports interwoven-preamble failure.

properties.claim: fin_col packages the current cell, preserves a span across span delimiters, ends a row on cr/crcr, or starts the next cell; periodic preambles copy the exact u/v token lists and tabskip, while an extra tab without a loop is changed to cr.
preconditions: Effective endv was delivered from an exhausted active v-template and the align group remains active.
expected_observations: Saved delimiter, structurally packaged cell/span/row outcomes, column-associated tabskip, periodic-copy, and extra-tab recovery follow §§791–795; align_state below 500000, a nonempty v-template, or an interposed input frame raises the interwoven-preamble fatal.
postconditions: Exactly one next-cell, continued-span, or completed-row state results and align_state is 1000000 during lookahead.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: finish ordinary and omitted cells at tab/span/cr/crcr and extend a periodic preamble.
Boundary: final declared column, first periodic copy, extra tab/span without a loop, corrected brace depth, and halign/valign row endings.
recovery_cases: Recovery: align_state below 500000 raises interwoven-preamble failure; extra tab/span without a periodic suffix becomes cr with the canonical diagnostic.

properties.claim: Cell completion naturally h-packs a halign cell or v-packages a valign cell, records its natural extent and dominant stretch/shrink orders and totals in an unset node, pops the cell semantic nest, and appends that unset node to the row list.
preconditions: fin_col has completed a cell or span list and mode is restricted horizontal or internal vertical.
expected_observations: The unset node carries the natural width or height, span count, dominant glue orders, and corresponding stretch/shrink totals.
postconditions: The cell semantic nest is popped and exactly one unset node is appended to the row list.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: empty and nonempty ordinary, omitted, and spanned cells in halign and valign.
Boundary: zero/nonzero stretch and shrink at each glue order, plus cur_span equal to and different from cur_align.
recovery_cases: Recovery: §796 specifies no diagnostic branch; packing diagnostics belong to the invoked hpack/vpackage contracts rather than a new alignment recovery.

properties.claim: For a cell spanning multiple columns, TeX82 counts the traversed alignrecords, finds or inserts the ordered span node for that count, and retains the maximum natural extent observed for the same start column and span count.
preconditions: §796 produced natural extent w with cur_span different from cur_align.
stimulus: Committed command-semantic case `span-width-record` observes the remaining boundary as a strict xfail linked to umber2-cpwg.
expected_observations: Span nodes remain ordered by span count and repeated observations update width only when the new natural extent is larger.
postconditions: The start-column alignrecord represents every observed span count by at most one maximum-width node.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: first, smaller repeated, and larger repeated widths for two- and three-column spans.
Boundary: one-column cells bypass the span list; the largest representable count is accepted.
recovery_cases: Recovery: a count beyond max_quarterword invokes TeX82 confusion(256 spans); no replacement width is recorded.
The strict xfail pins the first canonical-versus-current mismatch and rejects XPASS or changed failure.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

properties.claim: fin_row naturally h-packs a halign row or v-packs a valign row, moves halign adjustments after the row, marks the result unset with zero stretch, replays every_cr when nonnull, and returns to align_peek.
preconditions: fin_col reported a row-ending cr or crcr and the row list contains its tabskip and unset cells.
stimulus: Committed command-semantic case `package-unset-row` observes the remaining boundary as a strict xfail linked to umber2-fr3l.
expected_observations: The row is one unset box in the enclosing list; halign adjustments follow it, valign resets space_factor, and every_cr precedes lookahead.
postconditions: The row semantic nest is popped and align_peek owns the next noalign, close, crcr, or row transition.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: halign and valign rows with and without every_cr and halign adjustments.
Boundary: empty row material, one cell, multiple cells, and the final row before alignment close.
recovery_cases: Recovery: §799 defines no error branch; malformed row termination is handled earlier by §§791–792 and §§1126–1132.
The strict xfail pins the first canonical-versus-current mismatch and rejects XPASS or changed failure.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

properties.claim: fin_align verifies and removes the entry and alignment groups, selects display indentation when enclosed by math mode, performs the width, prototype, and unset-list phases, frees the prototype, pops the saved alignment state, and inserts the completed list into its environment.
preconditions: align_peek has delivered the alignment-closing right brace and the current group should be align_group.
stimulus: Committed command-semantic case `finish-orchestration` passes the happy-path group-restoration projection; direct typed-delivery coverage exercises both missing-group confusion branches.
expected_observations: The two align groups are removed before width work; pop_alignment occurs after the prototype is freed and before environment insertion.
postconditions: The active alignment has been converted and its list has been handed to the enclosing mode.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: finish halign, valign, nested, and displayed halign.
Boundary: zero and nonzero display_indent, empty and nonempty completed alignment lists.
recovery_cases: Recovery: a missing expected align_group invokes TeX82 confusion(align1) or confusion(align0) at the corresponding check.

cases: happy-path alignment groups restore before environment insertion

properties.claim: TeX82 computes final column widths by propagating each ordered span maximum after subtracting the preceding column width and natural tabskip; a column still at null_flag becomes zero and its following tabskip becomes zero_glue, while merged span nodes retain the larger equal-count width.
preconditions: The preamble alternates tabskip glue and alignrecords containing single-column widths and ordered span lists.
expected_observations: Each alignrecord becomes a dummy unset box with its final width; span constraints move to later columns in order and consumed span nodes are freed.
postconditions: Every column has a finite final width and the preamble is ready to serve as the packing prototype.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: no spans, overlapping spans, and competing equal-count maxima.
Boundary: null first/middle/final columns, zero/nonzero tabskip, and span width exactly equal to or greater than the existing target.
recovery_cases: Recovery: §§801–803 specify no user-error branch; list ordering is a procedure precondition and no modern validation behavior is asserted.

properties.claim: TeX82 packages the converted preamble to the saved to/spread specification: halign uses hpack with overfull_rule temporarily zero, while valign temporarily maps column widths to heights for vpack and then restores the fields.
preconditions: §§801–803 produced alternating dummy unset columns and tabskip glue and the saved specification remains on save_stack.
expected_observations: The prototype box records the glue sign, order, and ratio for the saved exact/additional specification without emitting an overfull rule in halign.
postconditions: Column widths are restored after valign prototype packing and pack_begin_line returns to zero.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: natural, to, and spread specifications for halign and valign.
Boundary: exact fit, stretch, shrink, and overfull prototype with overfull_rule nonzero on entry.
recovery_cases: Recovery: ordinary hpack/vpack diagnostics remain observable; §804 adds no alignment-specific recovery.

properties.claim: TeX82 traverses the completed list, delegates each unset row to row/cell setting, and replaces every running rule dimension with the corresponding prototype dimension; a nonzero display offset wraps and shifts that rule.
preconditions: The prototype box is available and the current list contains unset rows and possibly rule nodes.
stimulus: Committed command-semantic case `running-rules` observes the remaining boundary as a strict xfail linked to umber2-jnfg.
expected_observations: Only dimensions marked running are replaced; fixed rule dimensions remain fixed, and display-offset rules are h-packed and shifted by o.
postconditions: Every visited unset row is set and every visited rule has its final dimensions and offset representation.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: running width, height, depth, all-running, and all-fixed rules among unset rows.
Boundary: zero/nonzero display offset and null/non-null neighbors around a rule.
recovery_cases: Recovery: §§805–806 specify no diagnostic branch; non-unset non-rule nodes are traversed unchanged.
The strict xfail pins the first canonical-versus-current mismatch and rejects XPASS or changed failure.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

properties.claim: A row receives the prototype glue setting and extent, then each spanned cell accumulates prototype column widths and adjusted tabskip widths and gains explicit copied tabskip glue plus empty boxes for every covered intermediate column before conversion.
preconditions: An unset row contains unset cells and tabskip glue, and the packed prototype has matching alternating columns and glue.
expected_observations: The row copies prototype glue sign/order/ratio and shift; a span of n columns contributes n-1 tabskip/empty-box pairs while preserving the separately computed natural target t and final extent w.
postconditions: Subsequent cells begin at the same prototype column they would occupy in an unspanned row.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: one-, two-, and three-column cells under normal, stretching, and shrinking prototype glue.
Boundary: infinite-order stretch, normal-order shrink with rounding, and a span ending at the last column.
recovery_cases: Recovery: §§807–809 specify no user-error branch; prototype/list correspondence is a canonical precondition.

properties.claim: TeX82 converts each unset cell to an hlist node of final width in halign or a vlist node of final height in valign and computes its glue state from target t versus natural extent, using zero for absent stretch/shrink and capping excessive normal-order shrink at one.
preconditions: §§807–809 supplied final extent w and glue target t for an unset cell.
expected_observations: Equal target selects normal zero glue; larger target selects stretching; smaller target selects shrinking with the original dominant order.
postconditions: The cell has its final mode-specific node type and extent and inherits row cross-axis dimensions.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: equal, stretch, shrink, zero-capacity, and excessive-normal-shrink cases in halign and valign.
Boundary: one scaled-point difference, zero stretch/shrink, normal versus infinite order, and shrink exactly at capacity.
recovery_cases: Recovery: §§810–811 specify saturating glue behavior, not an error branch; no additional recovery is asserted.

properties.claim: TeX82 saves the current auxiliary field and completed list bounds, pops the alignment semantic nest, sends math-mode completion to the display-alignment fragment, or appends the list directly in nonmath modes and invokes build_page in vertical mode.
preconditions: All unset rows and rules have been set and link(head) through tail is the completed alignment list.
expected_observations: Display mode transfers p, q, and aux_save to §1206; horizontal mode appends without page building; vertical mode appends and calls build_page.
postconditions: The completed list is incorporated once into the enclosing environment and the enclosing auxiliary state follows its canonical mode path.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: empty/nonempty lists in enclosing math, horizontal, and vertical modes.
Boundary: null p with tail at head and a nonempty list whose q is its final node.
recovery_cases: Recovery: §812 defines no independent diagnostic; malformed display closure is owned by §§1206–1207.

properties.claim: A tab/span/cr reaching main control at align_state -1 or 1 is backed up behind an inserted balancing brace; at larger absolute depth it is merely misplaced, and misplaced noalign or omit reports and is ignored.
preconditions: An alignment-sensitive command escaped normal zero-depth interception or appears outside its admitted lifecycle point.
stimulus: Existing unit `recovery_inserted_left_brace_updates_active_alignment_state`; Phase 2 unit `alignment_misplaced_command_recovery_matrix` and semantic case `alignment-delimiter-recovery`.

Committed command-semantic case `misplaced-delimiter-recovery` observes the §1127 inserted-right-brace branch as a strict xfail linked to umber2-55mp: canonical reports one alignment recovery at align_state 1 where Umber reports none.
expected_observations: Backup correction, inserted brace delivery, restored zero depth, replayed delimiter interception, or misplaced-command discard is observed in canonical order.
postconditions: Recoverable ±1 cases resume the active cell; nonalignment cases do not create alignment state, templates, cells, rows, or spans.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: recover tab/span/cr in an active cell and diagnose tab/span/cr/noalign/omit outside their admitted alignment positions.
Boundary: align_state -1, +1, and absolute value greater than 2 across main-control modes.
recovery_cases: Recovery: missing left/right brace is inserted at ±1; otherwise tab/span/cr/noalign/omit produces its specific diagnostic and is ignored.

properties.claim: do_endv scans downward over exhausted token-list input levels until it finds v_template, reports interwoven-preamble failure if that boundary is absent or nonempty, then ends the paragraph and calls fin_col/fin_row in align_group or calls off_save in another group.
preconditions: Frozen end-template has expanded to effective endv.
stimulus: Existing unit `do_endv_stack_walk_accepts_only_empty_frames_above_v_template`; Phase 2 unit `do_endv_validates_template_and_group_matrix` and semantic case `alignment-endv-off-save`.

No committed command-semantic case can reach this boundary: effective endv arrives only from the frozen end-template, which ordinary INITEX source cannot name, so a brace-mismatched alignment reaches §1127 align_error instead. The pinned instrumented TeX82 oracle confirms the former `endv-off-save` source produced align_error and no fatal, and that source now owns tex82.align.misplaced-delimiter-omit-noalign-recovery. The Rust unit is the sole planned owner here.
expected_observations: Input-stack validation precedes end_graf and fin_col, and fin_row is called exactly when fin_col returns true.
postconditions: In align_group the completed column, and possibly row, has advanced; in another group control passes to the TeX82 off_save procedure.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: direct v_template and v_template beneath one or more exhausted token-list levels, with cell/span/row endings in halign and valign.
Boundary: nonempty intervening level, absent v_template, align_group, another save group, and bottom-level off_save.
recovery_cases: Recovery: absent/nonempty v_template ancestry raises interwoven-preamble failure; a wrong current group follows TeX82 off_save behavior, and bottom-level handling is defined by off_save rather than this section.

properties.claim: A right brace seen while align_group is active is backed up, then frozen cr is inserted so v-template and cell/row completion occur before the original brace is replayed to finish the alignment.
preconditions: A physical right brace closes an alignment entry before a row-ending cr.
expected_observations: Brace delivery and backup correction precede inserted-cr delivery, v-template completion, row completion, and brace replay.
postconditions: The cell and row close exactly once and the replayed brace reaches align_peek as the alignment terminator.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: close ordinary, omitted, and spanned final cells in top-level and nested halign/valign when cr is missing.
Boundary: empty/nonempty cell body and the first physical closing brace before v-template completion.
recovery_cases: Recovery: missing cr emits the canonical diagnostic and immutable frozen cr; no execution group is closed by the first brace delivery.

properties.claim: Closing no_align_group ends any paragraph, unsaves exactly that group, and resumes align_peek with the surrounding alignment state intact.
preconditions: align_peek selected noalign, consumed its opening brace, and no_align_group is current.
stimulus: Committed command-semantic case `noalign-group` observes the remaining boundary as a strict xfail linked to umber2-usol.
expected_observations: Noalign material occupies the enclosing row-list orientation and group close is followed by row lookahead, not cell-template replay.
postconditions: Local noalign assignments are unsaved and the next row, repeated noalign, crcr, or alignment close is selected normally.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: close empty and paragraph-producing noalign groups between halign and valign rows.
Boundary: nested alignment noalign, repeated noalign, following crcr, next row, and immediate alignment close.
recovery_cases: Recovery: missing noalign opener uses scan_left_brace recovery; misplaced noalign is handled by §1129 and never creates this group.
The strict xfail pins the first canonical-versus-current mismatch and rejects XPASS or changed failure.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

properties.claim: A completed display halign scans following assignments, requires the closing double math shift, reports and backs up a non-math-shift command for canonical missing-double-dollar recovery, restores the enclosing nest, inserts display penalties/glue around the alignment list, restores prev_depth, and resumes after display.
preconditions: fin_align completed a halign whose enclosing mode is display math.
expected_observations: Assignments precede delimiter validation; a direct non-math-shift produces Missing $$ inserted and is backed up/redelivered, while one closing math shift followed by a non-shift produces Display math should end with $$; the final vertical list exactly orders pre-penalty, above glue, alignment, post-penalty, below glue, restored-prevdepth baseline glue, then resumed material.
postconditions: Display mode is closed, prev_depth is restored, and normal post-display scanning resumes.
equivalence_cases: Semantic: finish single-row, multi-row, spanned, and omitted-cell display alignments after following assignments.
Boundary: valid double math shift, a non-math-shift requiring backup recovery, empty/nonempty result list, and nonzero display indentation.
recovery_cases: Recovery: the absent first closing math shift and the present first/missing second shift follow their distinct canonical diagnostics and backup paths without duplicating the alignment list.
